description:
About the job

We’re Hiring: CRO Specialist 

Based in Latin America | Full-Time | Remote 




About Us

Axis Reach is the performance marketing division of AxisKey (formerly Industry FinTech), focused on helping businesses grow through paid media, digital marketing, and data-driven strategies.




AxisKey is transforming the world of private capital markets through technology, automation, and operational excellence. Headquartered in Miami with a global team, we're scaling quickly and expanding our Marketing team in Latin America. 




We're a fast-paced, collaborative team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and measurable results. If you're passionate about performance marketing and excited to make a direct impact on business growth, we'd love to meet you! 




The Axis Way

At AxisKey, our culture isn't just something we talk about; it's how we work every day. We call it The Axis Way, and it guides how we collaborate, make decisions, and support one another. 




Our Why 

We exist to empower the entrepreneurial spirit by expanding access to the capital that fuels it. 




Our Values

Trust Above All
Builder Mindset
Own the Outcome
Raise the Bar
Feel Safe to Explore
Collective Strength




 If you're excited by our purpose and see yourself living these values every day, we'd love to meet you! 




The Role

We're hiring a CRO Specialist to own the end-to-end optimization of our landing pages and conversion funnels.




This is a hands-on role for someone who combines conversion strategy, technical implementation, AI-assisted workflows, analytics, and experimentation to continuously improve conversion performance. 

You'll build, publish, maintain, and optimize landing pages for AxisKey and, potentially, Axis Reach clients, while owning the technical setup behind them-including domains, integrations, analytics, and testing infrastructure. 




What You'll Do

Own the end-to-end landing page optimization process, from first draft to measurable conversion improvements.
Build, publish, maintain, and optimize landing pages for AxisKey and, potentially, Axis Reach clients.
Manage landing page domains, subdomains, DNS configuration, SSL certificates, redirects, and website deployments.
Configure and maintain integrations between landing pages, CRM platforms, analytics tools, and marketing automation systems.
Plan, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across page layouts, messaging, offers, forms, and calls-to-action.
Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, and funnel data to identify optimization opportunities and prioritize improvements.
Own the reporting cadence for conversion performance, experimentation results, and testing roadmaps.
Leverage AI tools and large language models (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Cursor) to accelerate copywriting, research, experimentation, analysis, and workflow optimization.
Recommend improvements to landing page structure, UX, messaging, and conversion strategy-not just execute predefined requirements.
Continuously identify new optimization opportunities and proactively drive initiatives that improve conversion performance.
Collaborate with Marketing, Design, and Development teams to rapidly launch, measure, and iterate experiments.




What We're Looking For

Must-Haves 

3+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Growth Marketing, or Landing Page Optimization.
Experience building, publishing, maintaining, and optimizing landing pages using Webflow, Unbounce, WordPress, or similar platforms.
Strong experience with CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, VWO, Optimizely, and similar platforms.
Experience planning, executing, and analyzing A/B and multivariate experiments.
Experience configuring landing page integrations with CRM, analytics, and marketing automation platforms.
Strong understanding of conversion funnels, user behavior, and website analytics.
Proficiency using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or similar LLMs to improve productivity, research, experimentation, and content creation.
Strong prompt engineering skills and the ability to effectively leverage AI for problem-solving and workflow optimization.
Strong UX and copywriting instincts, with the ability to recommend improvements-not just execute specifications.
Highly adaptable, curious, and comfortable learning new software, AI tools, and emerging technologies.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
A proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.




Bonus Points For 

Experience working in B2B SaaS, FinTech, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience with Cloudflare, DNS management, and website deployments.
Familiarity with Google Search Console.
Experience with Mixpanel or advanced product analytics platforms.
Experience using Figma or Framer.
Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make, or n8n for workflow automation.
Basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript knowledge.
Experience working with HubSpot or other CRM/marketing automation platforms.
Experience collaborating with designers and developers in agile environments.

title: SEO Content Optimizer
skills: SEO Content Optimizer
Content
Content Director

The SEO Content Optimizer leverages Green Marketing’s custom GPT models to produce and refine channel‑specific content: blogs, service and location pages, FAQs, Google Business Profile posts, brand development content, and social captions.

You’ll format, fact‑check, interlink, and polish AI outputs to meet our SEO, accessibility, and brand standards. This is an AI‑first, optimization role; ideal for someone with basic content writing and on‑page SEO knowledge who enjoys turning AI drafts into publication‑ready assets.
AI‑Enabled Content Production

Use Green Marketing’s custom GPT models to draft channel‑specific content (blogs, service and location pages, FAQs, landing pages, Google Business Profile posts, social captions, email snippets), then refine outputs to meet brand and SEO standards.
On‑Page Structure & SEO

Organize content with clear heading hierarchy (H1–H3), scannable paragraphs, bullet/numbered lists, tables when useful, and SEO elements including title tags, meta descriptions, URL slugs, and alt text, where applicable.
Image/Media Selection & Optimization
Source appropriate visuals from approved stock libraries or client assets; ensure image & content relevancy, alt text, and quality.
Internal Linking & Taxonomy

Implement and maintain interlinking across blogs, service pages, and location pages to support topical clusters (e.g., lawn care, landscaping, irrigation, hardscaping) and guide users toward pillar pages.
Editing & Quality Assurance

Audit AI output for accuracy, clarity, originality, brand voice, readability, and local relevance (services, service areas, seasonality). Resolve inconsistencies, remove fluff, and ensure compliance with checklists and tone guides.
Client Voice & Brand Fidelity

Tailor content to each client’s tone, offers, certifications, and service territories; accurately reflect nuances of the lawn & landscape niche (seasonal tasks, regional considerations, safety and licensing notes).
SOP Adherence & Improvement
Follow Green Marketing’s standard operating procedures and checklists consistently; document gaps and propose updates to prompts, templates, and knowledge base to improve throughput and quality.
Documentation & Asset Management
Maintain organized records of prompts, drafts, publishing statuses, image sources/attributions, and final URLs; keep content calendars and task boards up to date.
Basic understanding of on‑page SEO (title/meta, headings, internal links, alt text, URL slugs).
Basic understanding of AI tools (prompting, refining outputs, responsible use).
Communication skills: clear writing, concise edits, and professional client‑facing notes.
Strong attention to detail: consistency, grammar, brand voice, and checklist discipline.
Ability to follow SOPs and hit deadlines across multiple client accounts.
Comfortable using spreadsheets/task boards (content calendars, status tracking).
This is a fully remote position. Team members must maintain a professional, distraction‑free workspace and reliable connectivity to collaborate and deliver work on schedule.
Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), Monday–Friday.
Be available for stand‑ups, reviews, and client‑related meetings during these hours (observing ET, including Daylight Saving shifts).
Timeliness: 100% on‑time delivery; 0 overdue tasks per month.
SOP Adherence: ≥ 98% checklist compliance across formatting, metadata, interlinking, accessibility, and publishing steps.
Quality / Error Rate: ≤ 2 minor issues per 10 assets; 0 critical errors (e.g., incorrect client details, broken links, image licensing issues).
First‑Pass Approval: ≥ 90% “ready to publish” on initial submission.
Interlinking Coverage: 100% of eligible assets include required internal links per content brief/topic cluster.
Accessibility Completeness: Alt text on 100% of images; correct heading order on 100% of pages.
Revision Efficiency: Average 1.5 revision cycles per asset before final approval.
Throughput: Meets monthly cadence defined in the content plan (blogs, service/location pages, GBP posts, social captions).
Communication SLAs: Responds to team/client comments within working hours on the same business day.
Base Salary: $1,200 per month (USD).
PTO: Generous paid time off, including mental health days.
Additional details on holidays and accruals provided at offer stage.

About the job

About The Role

Our Uber Advertising Sales team is looking for a Client Partner to help accelerate growth across Non-Endemic industries in Mexico.

In this role, you will partner with some of Mexico's largest and most recognized brands, owning the strategy and performance of your vertical from end to end. You'll have the opportunity to shape long-term partnerships, drive business growth, and operate with a high level of ownership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

You will connect Uber's unique first-party mobility and delivery insights with your clients' marketing objectives. Trabajarás de forma muy cercana con los equipos de Ventas, Marketing y Revenue para asegurar que los leads generados se conviertan en crecimiento real para el negocio.

Planear, implementar y optimizar campañas de paid media en Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max), Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram) y redes de afiliados.

Gestionar y distribuir el presupuesto de inversión publicitaria (media budget) para maximizar el ROI, minimizar el CPA/CAC y escalar la adquisición de forma sostenible.

Definir, monitorear y reportar los KPIs de performance: CPL, CPC, CPA, ROAS, CAC, tasa de conversión, LTV y revenue atribuido a campañas.

Ejecutar pruebas A/B estructuradas de creatividades, audiencias, segmentaciones y landing pages para mejorar sistemáticamente el rendimiento de las campañas.
Explorar y activar nuevos canales de captación: programmatic advertising, native ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads u otros que representen oportunidades para el negocio.

skills: Own a defined book of active US customer accounts and know each one cold: their org, their hiring plans, who loves working with us, and where the headroom is.
Build and run a quarterly account plan for every priority account: where the growth will come from, who we need to meet, and what happens next. Your book, your strategy.

Run a relationship motion with our champions: regular, value-led check-ins; one specific intro ask at a time; every touch carrying something useful - never a "just checking in." The goal is trusted-advisor status, and you'll know you have it when retention stays high and your pipeline of new opportunities never dries up.

Map and multithread your accounts - buying centers, org charts, the next buyer - and keep that map live in HubSpot so the whole company sees what you see. Get introduced or go direct, and open the door.
Book and run expansion calls with US executives, and bring our founders in on the biggest opportunities.

Sell across everything Near offers: staffing, direct recruiting, engineering, finance, and AI talent.
Run your own operation: build your lists, run your sequences, keep your pipeline clean, forecast your numbers. You'll have modern tools (Clay, AI) and the autonomy to use them.
Help shape the playbook as you run it: this function is new, and what works for you becomes how Near does expansion.
Protect the base you're growing: spot delivery risk early and get it to our recruiting team fast.
Based in Latin America, with strong US time zone overlap.
Native-level English, spoken and written. You'll negotiate with US founders and CFOs, and write to them every day.
5+ years carrying a number in account management, account expansion, or full-cycle sales - with concrete proof you grew existing accounts, not just kept them.
Staffing, recruiting, or B2B services background is a strong plus.
Your wins were self-sourced. You've grown accounts without a machine behind you - nobody fed you meetings or handed you a deck.
Organized to a fault: many accounts, many contacts, long cycles, nothing dropped.
Fluent with modern sales tooling (CRM, sequencers, AI). You automate your own busywork.
Great at building and developing relationships.

The most AI-native team in the industry. We automate the busy work relentlessly. You'll spend your time on customers and closing, not on manual admin.
A machine that feeds your book. Marketing and Sales are crushing it and converting tons of net-new logos - every new customer they land becomes an account you can grow.
Company focus and real investment. Expansion is the focus for Q4, with significant investment behind it. This is not a side project, and you won't be doing it alone.
A high-performing team in every area, and a sales-first culture - inside the sales team and across the whole company.
Direct access to both co-founders. They're very involved in this motion; they'll get on calls with you, and you'll learn how they operate up close.
Great clients across many industries - one book, a wide range of businesses and buyers to learn from.

Clients who love us. 4.9 on G2, 4.8 on Clutch, 180+ reviews between the two - the best client and candidate satisfaction metrics in the industry. Expansion is a great job when people already rave about the product.
The growth curve. Join early, help define and shape the function, and get in a few years the growth it would take a decade to see at a more established company.
Work that matters. Every account you grow means more people across Latin America landing better jobs, better pay, and bigger careers. We've done it for thousands - you'll do it at scale.

description:
About the job

Ciudad de México (Híbrido/Remoto)

Full-time | Entry Level

$15,000 MXN mensuales de sueldo base + comisiones sin tope




Sobre Good Traffic




Good Traffic es la empresa detrás de los autos de rideshare con vehicle wraps, la plataforma de publicidad exterior construida sobre la red de rideshare mundial. Convertimos vehículos normales en espectaculares en movimiento — combinando car wrapping con tecnología de geolocalización y medición de impresiones para darle a las marcas más grandes del mundo un nuevo tipo de inventario de medios: branding premium en movimiento. Somos un equipo pequeño y ágil, y cada persona que se une tiene un impacto real en qué tan rápido crecemos.




Empieza tu carrera en ventas B2B con Good Traffic.




Como SDR serás el primer punto de contacto entre nuestra marca y los anunciantes que podrían beneficiarse de nuestro formato de vehículos wrapeados. No necesitas años de experiencia — solo hustle, curiosidad y ganas de aprender rápido. Vas a trabajar de cerca con nuestro equipo de ventas y marketing para encontrar a los prospectos correctos, iniciar conversaciones y agendar reuniones que se conviertan en relaciones reales con clientes.




Tu rol en el equipo




● Prospección 100% outbound hacia anunciantes potenciales que tú mismo identifiques.

● Entender las necesidades de los anunciantes potenciales e identificar cómo nuestro formato encaja con sus objetivos de marketing.

● Mantener un seguimiento cercano de tu propia actividad y números de pipeline.

● Planear, gestionar y organizar tu prospección y seguimientos en el CRM.

● Asegurarte de que cada lead e interacción quede correctamente registrado.

● Mapear y prospectar nuevas oportunidades de negocio en marcas de CPG, retail, enterprise, etc.




¿Qué vas a hacer?




● Identificar y prospectar activamente nuevos clientes potenciales mediante investigación, mapeo de mercado y herramientas de ventas.

● Contactar prospectos por llamadas, email y LinkedIn — aprendiendo a tener conversaciones reales sobre sus necesidades de marketing.

● Generar conversaciones con equipos de marketing, brand managers, agencias y otros tomadores de decisión.

● Desarrollar buenos hábitos para generar leads de calidad y mantener tu base de datos actualizada.

● Usar criterios de calificación claros para que solo avancen los leads con verdadero potencial. 

● Trabajar de cerca con el equipo de ventas para transferir leads calificados con contexto detallado de cada prospecto.

● Agendar reuniones calificadas para el equipo de ventas con prospectos que muestren interés real.

● Aprender a usar nuestro CRM y herramientas de ventas, manteniendo la información de leads y contactos precisa y actualizada.

● Familiarizarte con el producto de Branded Cars, nuestra metodología de medición de impresiones y nuestros casos de éxito, para poder explicarlos con confianza.

● Mantenerte al día sobre tendencias en publicidad Out-of-Home y el espacio de rideshare/movilidad.




¿A quién buscamos?




● Entre 0 y 2 años de experiencia profesional. Prácticas profesionales, proyectos universitarios o experiencia comercial también cuentan.

● Interés en construir una carrera en ventas, desarrollo de negocio o tecnología/publicidad.

● Muy buenas habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita.

● Persona proactiva y cómoda iniciando conversaciones.

● No te intimidan las llamadas en frío ni el rechazo.

● Organizado/a y capaz de manejar múltiples conversaciones y seguimientos al mismo tiempo.

● Te motivan los objetivos y te sientes cómodo/a midiendo tus propios resultados.

● Aprendes herramientas y procesos nuevos rápidamente.

● Español nativo o fluido.

● Inglés avanzado, con capacidad de mantener conversaciones profesionales.

● Licenciatura terminada o en curso es un plus, pero no obligatoria. Valoramos más tu capacidad, actitud y potencial que una carrera universitaria específica.




Es un plus si...




● Tienes experiencia previa en ventas, prospección, customer service, partnerships o business development.

● Has utilizado un CRM como HubSpot o Salesforce.

● Conoces LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Lusha u otras herramientas de prospección.

● Te interesa la publicidad, tecnología, medios, movilidad o AdTech.

● Has participado en organizaciones estudiantiles, emprendimientos, deportes competitivos o actividades donde hayas tenido que convencer, liderar o comunicarte con otras personas.




¿Por qué te va a encantar trabajar aquí?




● Compensación con upside real: $15,000 MXN mensuales de sueldo base + comisiones sin tope y bonos. Tu desempeño comercial impacta directamente lo que puedes ganar.

● Un camino claro de crecimiento: SDR → Senior SDR → Account Executive → Team Lead, y eventualmente mayores responsabilidades dentro del equipo comercial conforme Good Traffic siga creciendo. 

● Mentoría directa de nuestro equipo comercial y liderazgo — aprendizaje práctico en outbound sales, prospecting, cold calling, calificación de leads, gestión de CRM y pipeline, ventas B2B, y cómo venderle a grandes marcas y agencias.

● Impacto desde el principio: somos un equipo ágil y en crecimiento, así que tu trabajo no va a desaparecer dentro de una organización enorme. Las reuniones y oportunidades que generes se convierten directamente en nuevas campañas y crecimiento para Good Traffic.

● Exposición a algunas de las marcas, agencias y equipos de marketing más importantes del mundo mientras construimos una nueva categoría de publicidad exterior.




¿Te interesa empezar o acelerar tu carrera en ventas B2B con Good Traffic?




Aplica directamente por LinkedIn o envía correo a oscar@goodtraffic.com. No necesitas cumplir con el 100% de los requisitos. Queremos conocer personas con potencial, energía y ganas de aprender.

You will engage with senior leadership across Product, Marketing, and Engineering to showcase our platform’s unique competitive advantages. By joining our growing and collaborative environment, you will use inventive commercial strategies and a bias for action to ensure reliable revenue milestones.

WHO YOU ARE
New Business Focused: You thrive on pipeline creation and possess a proactive mindset. You systematically research, prioritize, and engage target accounts to build your own pipeline
Dual-Motion Capability: You seamlessly manage two distinct motions—building complex, multi-stakeholder strategic deals while maintaining a steady cadence of high-velocity, transactional wins

Complex Deal Architect: You excel at structuring, negotiating, and closing highly complex SaaS deals. You know how to conduct deep discovery, quantify business pain, build compelling financial business cases, and align executive stakeholders around large investments.

Partner & Ecosystem Collaborator: You have a proven track record of leveraging partners (SI, agency, and technology alliances) throughout the sales cycle to uncover opportunities, accelerate buying processes, and co-sell effectively

Analytical & Adaptable: You take a data-driven approach to your sales process—testing, refining, and adapting your strategy as market conditions and customer needs evolve

WHAT WE OFFER


Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we’ve got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave

A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching 
Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™. Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has been consistently recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was named a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2026. description:
About the job

🚀 ¿Por qué trabajar en Xepelin?
Xepelin está transformando las finanzas empresariales en Latinoamérica con una suite de productos que automatizan la gestión financiera y facilitan el acceso a liquidez. Con el objetivo de convertirse en el CFO digital de todo negocio, ha desarrollado tecnología financiera que impacta en todo el ecosistema empresarial. Gracias a la data obtenida por la interacción de +1M de empresas dentro de su network, se construye un sistema de inteligencia de negocios que da visibilidad de indicadores financieros y evaluaciones de riesgo de la red con la que se colabora, ayudando a que la toma de decisiones sea más rápida y segura.

Nuestros principios ¿Cómo operamos?
🎯 Ponemos a nuestros clientes en el centro

✨ Creemos e inspiramos

🧑‍💼 Actuamos como dueños

🏅 Lideramos con el ejemplo

🏆 Nos desafiamos para ganar

🧠 Tomamos riesgos con inteligencia

🤖 Usamos el poder de la tecnología

¿Qué estamos buscando?
En Xepelin estamos buscando personas creativas y visionarias que piensen fuera de la caja para sumarse a nuestro equipo. Si te apasiona resolver desafíos interesantes de alto impacto y quieres ser parte de un entorno dinámico que está transformando la industria financiera, ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Si te motiva el desafío de construir soluciones innovadoras en un entorno de rápido cambio, queremos conocerte.

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

Misión del rol
Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable? ¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado.

Principales responsabilidades


Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión
Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis
Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento
De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos
Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng





¿Qué necesitas para brillar?


Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables





Requisitos


2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti. 





Nuestros Beneficios:

🌴 Xepelin Balance

Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Por cada año que cumplas en Xepelin, te damos un día extra de vacaciones.

Balance days: 10 días libres adicionales al año, para disfrutar como quieras.

Beneficios Flexibles: Puntos flexibles en tu moneda local al mes para gastar en lo que quieras.

🚀 Xepelin Performance & Career

Plataformas de capacitación: Convenios con las mejores plataformas, como Udemy y Google Cloud Skill Boost.

Kit de Bienvenida: todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊

🤝 Xepelin Cares

Cobertura de salud: contamos con convenios de salud con proveedores de calidad o reembolsos según el país donde te encuentres.

Post Natal: te damos una semana extra de licencia post natal. ¡Nos interesa que estés con tu familia y seres queridos!

Matrimonio plus: Lleva tus planes al siguiente nivel, con una gift card y extendiendo tu permiso legal por matrimonio con dos días de regalo por Xepelin.

Estas herramientas asisten a nuestro equipo de reclutamiento, pero no reemplazan al criterio humano. Las decisiones finales de contratación son tomadas, en última instancia, por personas. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.

We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.

We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.

Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.

About The Team/role

The Collection Business Intelligence Specialist provides analytical and strategic support to Collections Operations team. This role is responsible for analyzing designing, calculating, and updating performance bonus schemes, maintaining operational metrics (KPIs / OKRs), and producing actionable insights to drive collection efficiency.

The position requires a strong technical skills on SQL, power BI, Tableu, advanced Excel. As well as understanding of recovery processes, delinquency metrics, and call center management in the collections environment. The specialist will support forecasting and dashboard development, perform in-depth performance analyses, and provide clear, data-driven recommendations to optimize strategies and floor performance.

This role also acts as a key liaison between the local operations team and the BI team in China, and Strategy local Team, ensuring alignment and operational interpretation of global delinquency dashboards.

Operational Metrics & Reporting

Forecasting & Strategy Support

 Collaborate with Operations and Strategy teams to identify optimization opportunities and implement adjustments to improve recovery rates and efficiency. 
Dashboards & Automation
 Develop and maintain dashboards and automated reports using SQL and BI tools. 
 Validate data sources and coordinate with the RD team for new data integrations when required.

Floor Control & Predictive Campaign Management

About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role:
We are searching for an Senior Specialist Employee Services to join the Global Business Services (GBS) People & Culture (P&C) team. In this role, the Senior Specialist provides efficient and highly informative first point-of-contact service to all employees, their managers and business partners. 
 
Focused on a seamless customer experience and great customer care, the Senior Specialist uses information from multiple systems and resources to respond to inquiries; provides navigational support to employees on self-service/HR tools such as Workday and ServiceNow and routing/escalating inquiries for advanced support. Using the case management system, the Senior Specialist accurately processes, records, closes or escalates transactions in accordance with established service level agreements. This role collects required information or back-up documentation from employees or external customers. This includes tactfully asking customers probing questions to establish context and ensure the solutions offered or the escalation path is appropriate and most likely to succeed. 
 
The Senior Specialist role provides feedback internally, proposing new and effective ways to resolve problems and improve productivity (i.e., continuous improvement efforts), while maintaining broad knowledge of policies, procedures, and resources. 
 
Your Role Accountabilities:

Analyze and resolve different types of requests from employees or clients.
Handle inbound requests via phone, email, the HR-Portal, or other access channels. 
Perform individual employee data transactions and data-entry in Workday and other systems. 
Troubleshoot payroll and time off inquiries, recalculations, employment verifications (VOE/VOIs), direct deposit setups, pay and tax document re-issues, data updates, etc. 
Provide support for self-service and P&C technology tools for employees and customers. 
Ensure completeness of case notes, aligning with company and audit expectations.
Assisting customers to increase awareness of self-service resources and promote self-sufficiency. 
Ensure confidentiality information when processing transactions and addressing employee inquiries. 
Perform and track administrative (no call) departmental tasks, including report reviewing, data updates, mailing, filing, sending correspondence, and records management. 

 
Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related field
Fluent in English 
Experience with Human Resources administrative or related experience required, preferably with supervisory responsibilities from a global entertainment environment.
Must be able to maintain confidentiality and use confidential information appropriately.




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

Location: These opportunities are available in the APAC and AMER regions and are remote positions.

The role entails:


Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You will develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive up-sells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
Customer interactions and support to your team: resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention ensuring timely resolution.
Team management: passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. 
Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.



What We Are Looking For In You


Excellent academic results at school and university
Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject
Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
Experience growing and developing a CSM team
Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events



Nice-to-have Skills


Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.



What We Offer You

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.


Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others

About the job

Our client is a fast-growing digital healthcare company that helps individuals access affordable telehealth services and prescription treatments through a seamless online experience. Focused on delivering exceptional customer care, the company combines technology, licensed medical professionals, and personalized support to guide customers throughout their wellness journey.

As the company continues to grow, they are seeking a Sales & Customer Engagement Specialist to support prospective customers through consultative, phone-based sales conversations and help qualified individuals confidently move through the enrollment process.




Role Overview

The Sales & Customer Engagement Specialist will be responsible for handling inbound phone calls from prospective customers interested in the company's telehealth services and prescription treatment options.

The Sales & Customer Engagement Specialist will build rapport, understand customer needs and concerns, address objections, explain the purchasing process, and guide qualified prospects toward enrollment. This is a consultative sales role that requires balancing conversion goals with an empathetic, customer-first approach.

This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, skilled at closing warm inbound opportunities, and comfortable navigating sensitive health and wellness conversations with professionalism and empathy.




Location

Fully Remote | 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM PST




Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Conversion

Handle inbound sales calls from prospective customers interested in the company's services.
Guide qualified prospects through the enrollment and purchasing process.
Identify customer needs, motivations, concerns, and buying signals during conversations.
Confidently move qualified opportunities toward a successful close.
Answer non-clinical questions regarding pricing, enrollment, promotions, timelines, and the purchasing process.
Explain available promotions, discounts, and special offers according to company guidelines.
Follow up with interested prospects when additional communication is appropriate.
Maintain a consultative approach focused on helping customers make informed purchasing decisions.

Build rapport and establish trust quickly during inbound conversations.
Use active listening to understand customer concerns and motivations.
Address objections related to pricing, enrollment, processes, and other non-clinical concerns.
Help customers work through hesitation without relying on high-pressure sales tactics.
Maintain empathy and professionalism during sensitive conversations related to health and wellness.
Create a positive customer experience that supports both conversion and long-term customer retention.




Compliance & Customer Information

Protect confidential customer information and follow HIPAA requirements.
Maintain appropriate boundaries between sales conversations and clinical guidance.
Escalate medical and clinical questions to licensed healthcare professionals according to established procedures.
Follow company guidelines regarding approved customer communications and information.
Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions.




CRM & Pipeline Management

Manage customer interactions and sales activities within the company's CRM platform.
Maintain detailed and accurate notes for customer conversations.
Keep prospect information, follow-up activities, and customer status up to date.
Track interested prospects and ensure appropriate follow-up occurs.
Maintain organized customer records throughout the enrollment process.




Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Collaborate with internal teams to provide a smooth customer experience.
Participate in ongoing sales coaching, quality assurance reviews, and product training.
Apply coaching and feedback to improve sales conversations and conversion performance.
Quickly develop strong knowledge of the company's products, promotions, processes, and approved customer information.
Continuously improve objection handling, active listening, and consultative sales techniques.




Qualifications

Experience

2+ years of experience in inbound sales, inside sales, consultative sales, or a high-performing customer-facing role.
Proven experience closing warm inbound sales opportunities.
Experience handling objections and converting interested prospects into customers.
Experience managing customer conversations through structured sales processes.
Customer service experience is strongly preferred.
Experience using CRM platforms to document customer interactions and sales activity.




Skills

Strong phone-based sales and consultative selling skills.
Strong active listening skills with the ability to understand customer needs and concerns.
Ability to quickly establish rapport and trust with prospective customers.
Strong objection-handling and closing abilities.
High emotional intelligence and ability to navigate sensitive conversations professionally.
Ability to balance customer experience with sales and conversion objectives.
Experience using CRM platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar systems.
Strong attention to detail when documenting customer conversations and follow-up activities.
Ability to quickly learn new products, processes, systems, and workflows.
Ability to follow structured sales, compliance, and escalation procedures.

Rapport and trust are established quickly during inbound conversations.

SIG competencies

We are looking for people who are willing to consistently achieve results, even under tough circumstances, employees who create a climate where everyone is motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives. If you actively seek new ways to grow and be challenged, if you develop people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals, SIG is the place for you. To deliver better for our customers, our future colleagues build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions. description:
About the job

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Senior Executive Search, GOC

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive Search who will:


Develop strong relationships with counterparts in WPP Media’s regional teams (Europe, United States and Asia). 
Support the implementation of digital campaigns and ads according to guidelines with platforms such as Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon Search, Search Ads 360, etc. 
Ensure campaigns comply with WPP Media’s global policies and guidelines. 
Monitor campaigns daily on each of the platforms and ensure accuracy of data across platforms for campaign reporting. 
Generate daily campaign reports for reporting to regional Search teams. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Bachelor’s degree. 
Advanced English level (B2–C2). 
Have 1.5-2 years of experience implementing paid Search campaigns on platforms such as Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon Search, etc. 
Advanced Excel skills. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

For Colombia

This position is in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed within Colombian territory. Only candidates residing in Colombia with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work contracts do not allow employment or relocation abroad.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. 

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

About the job

At Bosch Service Solutions (SO), we support leading Bosch business units by delivering high-quality customer and operational services that drive business growth and excellence.

This opportunity supports three dynamic product divisions: Power Tools, Home Comfort, and Automotive Accessories, businesses that rely on strong field execution and retail presence across Mexico. Through a nationwide network of promoters and field teams, these divisions bring innovative solutions and products closer to customers every day.

Job Description

As a Full Cycle Recruiter & Hub Coordinator you will be responsible for leading the full talent acquisition lifecycle for high-volume retail positions across Bosch's Power Tools, Home Comfort, and Automotive Accessories businesses.

This role goes beyond recruitment. You will act as the primary point of contact for Hiring Managers and business stakeholders, owning the end-to-end hiring process from requisition intake through onboarding readiness. You will be responsible for recruitment execution, stakeholder management, reporting, preboarding coordination, hiring administration, documentation tracking, and new hire readiness.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong ownership, and is capable of managing multiple priorities while delivering an exceptional candidate and customer experience.

Talent Acquisition


Manage full-cycle recruitment for high-volume retail, field sales, promoter, merchandising, and commercial positions.

Follow up on pending documentation and resolve issues that could impact hiring timelines.

description:
About the job

Please Note: We are targeting individuals that live in Brazil, Colombia, and Mexico for this role. We are not currently accepting candidates from the United States.




Who We Are

Goodway Group is one of AdAge's 2026's BEST PLACES TO WORK! As an independent and remote-first media and marketing services firm with a 90+ year history, Goodway Group has the security of an established company combined with a start-up feel. With leading data-driven and technology-enabled digital media and marketing services firm with teams in the U.S. and the UK, our diverse team of digital strategists, media practitioners, technologists and data scientists have won the most prestigious awards for innovative marketing technology, impactful work and inclusive remote-first places to work including being honored as a multiyear winner in Ad Age Best Places to Work, Ad Exchanger's Best Use of Technology by an Agency Award and two MarTech Breakthrough Awards and a certified service partner to The Trade Desk. 




Who You Are

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will build and maintain the internal applications that power Goodway's products and workflows. You'll develop intuitive user experiences, scalable backend services, and APIs that enable our teams to make smarter, data-driven decisions. Working closely with Product, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science, you'll help deliver software that is reliable, maintainable, and built with the end user in mind.




What You Will Do

Build modern web applications - Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS technologies.
Develop backend services and APIs - Build scalable services and integrations that connect applications with internal platforms, data services, and third-party systems.
Create great user experiences - Develop responsive interfaces and workflow tools that simplify complex business processes and data visualization.
Collaborate across teams - Partner with Product, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science to translate business requirements into thoughtful technical solutions.
Write high-quality software - Develop clean, maintainable, well-tested code while participating in code reviews and following engineering best practices.
Contribute to technical design - Participate in architecture and design discussions, helping shape solutions that balance scalability, maintainability, and speed of delivery.
Continuously improve - Identify opportunities to improve application performance, deployment processes, developer experience, and internal workflows.




What You Bring

4+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Node.js
Experience building REST APIs and modern web applications
Experience working with AWS cloud services
Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices
Strong understanding of software design, testing, and debugging
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a remote environment
Experience building data-driven applications or dashboards
Familiarity with SQL and data visualization concepts
Experience with Docker or Kubernetes
Exposure to Python or data engineering workflows
Experience integrating AI or automation into software applications




As part of the interview process, candidates will be asked to do a live coding interview with members of our engineering team. You'll be asked to share your screen and talk through your thought process while solving a problem. You may use any programming language and code editor you're comfortable with, but AI tools are not permitted.

Check us out at www.goodwaygroup.com to learn more!




If you identify as a female candidate, and feel you can do this role even if there are a few things perhaps you've not done, please apply anyway! Goodway Group is 70% Female! Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

As part of the Operations team, you will play a key role in ensuring that our events run smoothly from planning to closure, leading a team and making sure that every operational detail is under control.

This role is highly hands-on and requires someone organized, structured, and capable of leading a team in high-paced and dynamic environments. You will also interact with other departments such as Sales, Originals, and Marketing, ensuring that operations are aligned with business goals.From day 1, you will be leading events and managing a team onsite, always with the support of your peers and managers, making a direct impact on our operations and customer experience.

You have a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Data Analytics or related fields.

You embrace change and you create it! We are a fast-growing company and we want you to help us to adapt to these changes.
